{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either variable
complete_data = penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dropna()

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = complete_data['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_data['body_mass_g'])

print(f'Pearson correlation: {correlation:.6f}')

# Confirm the number of complete cases
print(f'Number of complete cases: {len(complete_data)}')"}
